title: Tavi
_note: PRO_01 Morning, the child beat (MAIN_QUEST.md section 2).

bone.speaker: Tavi
bone.text: Da. I found a bone. Guess what it's from.

choices.spoken: A fish. A very old, very stubborn one.
Don't tell your mother, but it's a man's finger.

after.speaker: Tavi
after.text: I'm keeping it. With the shell and the beetle. Mama says not in the bowl.

finger.speaker: Tavi
finger.text: A finger! Mama, Da says it's a man's... Mama's looking at you.

idle.speaker: Tavi
idle.text: Can I hold the nails? I'll hold them really still.
